ContainedObjects.LuaScript:
LOBO_VEYRA_PREVIEW_SAFE=false
local colors={'White','Brown','Red','Orange','Yellow','Green','Teal','Blue','Purple','Pink','Grey','Black'}
local function disablePreviewPhysics()
 if self.loading_custom then return false end
 local ok,count=pcall(function()
  local count=0
  for _,kind in ipairs({'MeshCollider','BoxCollider','SphereCollider','CapsuleCollider'})do
   for _,c in ipairs(self.getComponentsInChildren(kind)or {})do
    c.set('enabled',false)
    if c.get('enabled')~=false then return -1 end
    count=count+1
   end
  end
  return count
 end)
 return ok and count>0
end
function onLoad()
 LOBO_VEYRA_PREVIEW_SAFE=false
 self.interactable=false;self.setLock(true);self.setInvisibleTo(colors)
 self.setPosition({x=90,y=-20,z=90})
 Wait.condition(function()LOBO_VEYRA_PREVIEW_SAFE=true end,disablePreviewPhysics,30)
end

ContainedObjects.Name: Custom_Assetbundle
ContainedObjects.LuaScript:
local enabled=true
local function apply()
 if self.AssetBundle then
  local index=enabled and 2 or 0
  if self.AssetBundle.getLoopingEffectIndex()~=index then self.AssetBundle.playLoopingEffect(index)end
 end
 for _,c in ipairs(self.getComponentsInChildren('Light')or{})do
  c.set('enabled',enabled);c.set('range',2.1);c.set('intensity',0.38);c.set('shadows',0)
  c.set('color',Color(1,0.73,0.42,1))
 end
 for _,r in ipairs(self.getComponentsInChildren('MeshRenderer')or{})do r.set('enabled',false)end
 for _,kind in ipairs({'MeshCollider','BoxCollider','SphereCollider','CapsuleCollider'})do
  for _,c in ipairs(self.getComponentsInChildren(kind)or{})do c.set('enabled',false)end
 end
end
function setBillboardLight(p)enabled=p.enabled==true;apply()end
function onLoad()
 self.setLock(true);self.interactable=false
 Wait.condition(apply,function()return not self.loading_custom end,30)
end

-- The shared coordinator applies visibility after host checks.
function setNeon(p)end

local function visibilityView()
 followBuildingLights()
 for b,c in pairs(config.buildingControls)do
  local o,n=currentBuilding(b)
  if o then
   local hidden={};local target={};local locked=o.getLock()
   for _,color in ipairs(colors)do
    local v=state.views[color] and state.views[color][b]or 0
    local want=math.max(n,math.min(c.maxState,1+v))
    local p=obj((config.privateProxies[b]or {})[tostring(want)])
    if want~=n and (not locked or not previewReady(p))then want=n end
    target[color]=want;if want~=n then hidden[#hidden+1]=color end
   end
   o.setInvisibleTo(hidden)
   for phase,g in pairs(config.privateProxies[b]or {})do
    local p=obj(g)
    if p then
     local hide={};local show=false
     for _,color in ipairs(colors)do
      if target[color]~=tonumber(phase)or n==tonumber(phase)then hide[#hide+1]=color else show=true end
     end
     if show and locked and previewReady(p)then
      p.setPosition(o.getPosition());p.setRotation(o.getRotation());p.setScale(o.getScale());p.setInvisibleTo(hide)
     else parkPreview(p)end
    end
   end
  end
 end
end

   local signature=string.format('%s:%.4f:%.4f:%.4f:%.4f:%.4f:%.4f:%.4f:%.4f:%.4f',o.getGUID(),p.x,p.y,p.z,r.x,r.y,r.z,s.x,s.y,s.z)

   for phase=1,config.buildingControls[b].maxState do
    local p=obj((config.privateProxies[b]or {})[tostring(phase)])
    signature=signature..':'..tostring(previewReady(p))

  end
 end

end
